title: Bram and the Promise
author: Lior Okonkwo
blurb: Dominic Oyelaran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
